newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Danish 96 c/a surplus seen at 12.0 bln DK.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Danish 96 c/a surplus seen at 12.0 bln DK.

text.p: Denmark's Economy Ministry said on Tuesday it expected the current account to show a 12.0 billion crown surplus at end-1996, 13.0 billion crowns in 1997 and 15.0 billion crowns in 1998.
The 1995 current account surplus was 8.1 billion crowns.
The figures in the ministry's latest economic survey compared with a forecast for 1996 of 10.3 billion crowns and 10.8 billion crowns for 1997 in its last survey in October.
